# Since last visit

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
diffPresent = diff.entities !== undefined
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
diffTotals = diffPresent
  ? ({
      status: diff.entities.status_changed.length,
      added: diff.entities.added.length,
      removed: diff.entities.removed.length,
      edgesAdded: diff.edges.added.length,
      edgesRemoved: diff.edges.removed.length,
      total:
        diff.entities.status_changed.length +
        diff.entities.added.length +
        diff.entities.removed.length +
        diff.edges.added.length +
        diff.edges.removed.length
    })
  : null
```

## Row {height="26%"}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| title: "What changed"
{
  const framing = md`This page diffs the project graph across the last "visit": from the previous \`docs/STATE.md\` heartbeat commit (STATE regenerates when work concludes, so its history marks session ends) to \`HEAD\`. Status moves, arrivals, and edge changes below are everything that landed in between.`;
  const detail = !diffPresent
    ? md`No prior \`docs/STATE.md\` commit to anchor on — this is the first heartbeat, so there is no “last visit” to diff against.`
    : diffTotals.total === 0
      ? md`**Nothing since the last heartbeat** (\`${diff.from.commit.slice(0,8)}\` → \`${diff.to.commit.slice(0,8)}\`). Any work in progress is in the uncommitted working tree, not here.`
      : md`From \`${diff.from.commit.slice(0,8)}\` → \`${diff.to.commit.slice(0,8)}\`: **${diffTotals.status}** status move(s), **${diffTotals.added}** new / **${diffTotals.removed}** removed entit(y/ies), **${diffTotals.edgesAdded}** / **${diffTotals.edgesRemoved}** edge(s) added / removed.`;
  return html`${framing}${detail}`;
}
```

```{ojs}
  ? md`_none_`

      { rows: 30 }
    )
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| title: "Arrivals & departures"
!diffPresent || (diff.entities.added.length === 0 && diff.entities.removed.length === 0)
  ? md`_no entities added or removed_`
  : Inputs.table(
      [
        ...diff.entities.added.map(e => ({ change: "+ new", id: e.id, kind: e.kind, title: e.title })),
        ...diff.entities.removed.map(e => ({ change: "− gone", id: e.id, kind: e.kind, title: e.title }))
      ],
      { rows: 30 }
    )
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| title: "Edges moved"
!diffPresent || (diff.edges.added.length === 0 && diff.edges.removed.length === 0)
  ? md`_no edges added or removed_`
  : md`${[
      ...diff.edges.added.map(e => "\`+ " + e + "\`"),
      ...diff.edges.removed.map(e => "\`− " + e + "\`")
    ].join("\n\n")}`
```

# Coverage

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
coverageRows = coverage.measured.map(m => {
  const row = { subject: m.id };
  for (const s of coverage.suites) row[s] = m.counts[s] ?? 0;
  row.total = m.total;
  return row;
})
```

# Bench

## Row {height="16%"}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| title: "Bench state"
md`Latest committed run: \`${state.bench.latest_run ?? "none"}\` — **${state.bench.runs.length}** record(s) across **${state.bench.suites.length}** suite(s), **${state.bench.run_ids.length}** committed run set(s) (${state.bench.run_ids.map(r => "\`" + r + "\`").join(" → ")}). ${state.bench.run_ids.length < 2 ? "One run set is a baseline read of points, not yet a trend; each new run adds a column in time." : "Each run set is a column in time; the per-metric table below reads left to right."}`
```

## Row {height="30%"}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| title: "Per suite — pass rate & cost"
Inputs.table(
  state.bench.suites.map(s => ({
    suite: s.suite,
    runs: s.runs,
    pass: s.pass,
    fail: s.fail,
    pass_rate: s.runs ? (100 * s.pass / s.runs).toFixed(0) + "%" : "—",
    cost_usd: "$" + s.cost_usd.toFixed(3)
  })),
  { layout: "auto" }
)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| title: "Per-metric trend (kernel-computed; columns = run sets, chronological)"
{
  const mv = state.bench.metric_values;
  if (mv.length === 0) return md`No metric values — commit a run set and \`evals/metrics.json\`.`;
  const rows = new Map();
  for (const m of mv) {
    const key = m.subject + " " + m.metric;
    if (!rows.has(key)) rows.set(key, { subject: m.subject.replace(/^(agent|skill):/, ""), metric: m.metric });
    rows.get(key)[m.run_id] =
      m.value === null ? "—" : m.value.toFixed(2) + (m.meets_threshold === false ? " ✗" : "");
  }
  const columns = ["subject", "metric", ...state.bench.run_ids];
  return Inputs.table([...rows.values()], { columns, layout: "auto" });
}
```
